title: Download the 12 Rules to Learn to Code eBook [Latest Edition]
summary: Resource page offering a free eBook of twelve study habits the instructor has seen in her strongest students. The page itself is a short motivational note plus a download link; it contains no technical content.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: The eBook collects 12 study tips for learning to code, drawn from the App Brewery's experience teaching bootcamp students.
The download link sits at the bottom of the lecture page (visible once enrolled).
The Udemy mobile app may not handle the download; open the lecture on a desktop browser to get the PDF.

(Extra) A copy is in the reference repo at 'Section 01 - Front-End Web Development/01.02 - 12 Rules to Learn to Code.pdf', alongside a Cornell-notes template PDF (01.03) that pairs with the note-taking advice in lecture 7.

pitfalls: Trying to download from the Udemy mobile app instead of a desktop browser.

playground.coverage: No playground lesson yet (download page only).
